name: Lipstick Adv.EX
source:
The story starts as a usual day for Detective Ichijou Megumi and his assistant, Hidaka Koume. Like in many detective games, this detective has not gotten any case for a long time. As a result, he just wanders aimlessly around the town. He flirts with a female in the public library and helps Koume's Detective Club find out the culprit behind the theft of her classmate's clothes. While these two events seemed irrelevant, it is a slow pavement behind a big evil (?!) scheme hidden in the city.

In this game, you will be switching between the perspectives of the detective and his assistant.

[Edited from [url=http://www.densetsu.com/display.php?id=299]Anime Densetsu[/url]]
translation:
故事从侦探一条惠美与助手日高小梅平凡的一天开始。和许多侦探游戏里的主角一样，这名侦探已经很久没有接到委托，只能漫无目的地在城里闲逛。他在公共图书馆搭讪一名女性，又帮助小梅的侦探社查出偷走同学衣服的犯人。两件看似毫无关联的小事，其实在一步步铺陈城市中隐藏的庞大邪恶阴谋？！

游戏中，玩家会在侦探与助手的视角之间切换。

[根据 [url=http://www.densetsu.com/display.php?id=299]Anime Densetsu[/url]编辑]
